description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
These are the same OEM security screws that were used to mount the ignition switch when your Samurai rolled off the production line.
If you have had to grind off the ignition security screws in order to remove the ignition you can once again have the same secure ignition switch that you originally had by simply installing these genuine OEM ignition security screws.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – 8mm x 1.25 course thread, Security Installation Screws
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1992 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1992 All Models
